claim: You can specify the ActiveMQ version when creating a new broker via the AWS Management Console or the CreateBroker API; on the AWS Management Console, Amazon MQ provides the latest available version by default.

qualifiers.condition: at broker creation; optional, the console defaults to the latest version

evidence.quote: You can specify the ActiveMQ version (e.g. ActiveMQ 5.17.6) when creating a new broker via the AWS Management Console or the CreateBroker API. Amazon MQ will provide the latest version available by default on the AWS Management Console.
